Current focus

Cotton soft home textiles

Our lead range is cotton soft home textiles for importers, distributors and home-lifestyle brands — hand block-printed and woven cotton ranges built for repeat orders, not one-offs.

We source from India's established textile clusters: Jaipur & Sanganer for hand block printing, Panipat for throws and light quilts, and Karur for table & kitchen linen. Private label is available from makers, and small trial orders are possible — some makers from as low as 25–100 pieces — so a first order can start small and grow.

  • Cushion covers — hand block-printed and woven cotton, in your designs and sizes
  • Table & kitchen linen — tablecloths, runners, napkins, aprons and tea towels from Karur
  • Throws & light quilts — woven cotton throws and light quilts from Panipat and Jaipur
  • Private label & samples — your label on the maker's production, with samples coordinated before bulk
Second range

Eco bags: custom-printed jute & cotton bags

Our second range is reusable eco packaging for importers, promotional-product distributors and eco-conscious brands — made by Indian manufacturers and printed with your branding.

The makers in this range are concentrated in Kolkata and West Bengal — India's historic jute belt, where the craft, the raw material and the export experience sit side by side. Selected makers also accept small trial orders, some from as low as 100–500 pieces, so a first order can be a low-risk trial instead of a leap of faith.

  • Jute bags — custom-printed shoppers, promotional bags and pouches in natural jute
  • Cotton & canvas bags — totes and carry bags for retail, events and gifting
  • Logo printing & private label — your logo, artwork and branding on the manufacturer's own production, with samples coordinated before bulk
  • Built around your brief — size, fabric, handles and print confirmed against your exact requirement
Phase 2 — FIBC bulk bags (later)

Not our current focus. Email us if relevant and we will tell you honestly where we stand.

What we do

Four things, done properly

We are a brokerage, not a trader. We hold no stock and mark up no goods — we qualify, verify, coordinate and follow through.

01

Buyer requirement qualification

We pin down the product, specification, quantity, destination and timeline first — so suppliers quote on a real brief, not a guess.

02

Supplier verification

We check the manufacturer's registration, certifications, production capacity and export readiness before they ever see your requirement.

03

Quotation & sample coordination

We collect and organise quotations, and coordinate samples so you can approve quality before committing to a bulk order.

04

Communication follow-through

One thread, chased properly — from enquiry through production updates to delivery, instead of messages that go quiet.

How we work

From enquiry to delivery, in five steps

1

Share your requirement

Tell us the product, specification, quantity, destination and timeline.

You receive: a written summary of your requirement as we understood it, for your confirmation.

2

We verify matching suppliers

We shortlist manufacturers and check them against your brief.

You receive: a shortlist of verified suppliers with their documents — registration and certifications on file.

3

Quotation & samples

You receive organised quotations and samples to approve.

You receive: written quotations from the manufacturers' own prices, and coordinated samples on request.

4

Written agreement

Terms — including our commission — are agreed in writing before introduction.

You receive: a written agreement covering product terms and our commission — agreed before any introduction.

5

Order coordination

We coordinate communication through production to delivery.

You receive: progress updates at each stage until dispatch and delivery.

Transparent brokerage

How we earn — no hidden markup

SOURCETRA is a transparent brokerage. Our commission is agreed in writing before any buyer–supplier introduction, so both sides know exactly how we earn. Product prices are the manufacturer's own prices — we add no hidden markup. Payments for goods flow directly between buyer and supplier; SOURCETRA never holds buyer money.

Straight answers

Questions buyers ask us

Do you sell or ship the goods yourselves?

No. SOURCETRA is a sourcing brokerage with no inventory. The manufacturer supplies and ships the goods; our role is qualification, verification, coordination and follow-through.

How does SOURCETRA earn?

Through a commission / brokerage fee that is agreed in writing before any buyer–supplier introduction. There are no hidden margins added to the price of your goods.

Do you take a hidden commission from the supplier?

No. How we earn is agreed in writing with the party that engages us, before any introduction is made. Prices you see are the manufacturer's own prices, and goods payments go directly between buyer and supplier.

Who do I pay for my order?

You pay the supplier directly. Payment for goods always flows buyer → supplier; SOURCETRA never holds buyer money.

Can I get samples before a bulk order?

Yes — sample coordination is a standard step in how we work. Quotations and samples come before any written agreement and bulk order, so you approve quality first.

What do you need from me to start?

Just your requirement: product, specification (as far as you know it), quantity, destination and timeline. Use the enquiry email below or write to us directly — qualifying the brief properly is our job.
